prediction.clinical_reasoning: The patient's chief complaint of feeling heavy on one side near the flank and decreased appetite is suggestive of acute pancreatitis. This condition can cause epigastric pain radiating to the back, which may present as heaviness in the affected quadrant. The loss of appetite is a common symptom associated with inflammation of the pancreas. However, further diagnostic tests are necessary to confirm the diagnosis.  Recommended Tests: - Serum amylase and lipase levels - CT scan of the abdomen
